title: Transfer Fcn Lead or Lag
text: Implement discrete-time lead or lag compensator, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Pole of compensator (in Z plane)} sets the pole, {Zero of compensator (in Z plane)}, {Initial condition for previous input}, {Initial condition for previous output} and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition for previous input
params.values: Initial condition for previous input 0.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial condition for previous output
params.values: Initial condition for previous output 0.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
